title: Earthquake (California FAIR Plan policies page)
claims: The page states: 'The California FAIR Plan offers earthquake coverage through the California Earthquake Authority (CEA) as a separate policy for customers with a California FAIR Plan Dwelling Fire policy.'

The page states: 'A stand-alone earthquake policy written by the California FAIR Plan is not available. You must have an in-force California FAIR Plan policy to qualify for CEA coverage through the California FAIR Plan.'
updateCadence: Updated by the FAIR Plan as its product offerings change.
